name: Yamanasaurus
sum: Yamanasaurus is a saltasaurine titanosaur from the Rio Playas Formation of Ecuador, the first non-avian dinosaur described from that country.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; fragments of a single individual.
biology: It probably fed on low vegetation, and is thought to be close to Neuquensaurus.
author: Apesteguía et al. 2020

sources.text: Apesteguía, S.; Soto Luzuriaga, J.E.; Gallina, P.A.; Tamay Granda, J.; Guamán Jaramillo, G.A. 2019. The first dinosaur remains from the Cretaceous of Ecuador. Cretaceous Research 108. doi:10.1016/j.cretres.2019.104345
